exposure: Antibiotic use during the first 2 years of life
outcome: ADHD diagnosis or redeemed ADHD medication prescriptions
cohort: Native Danish singleton live births in Denmark from 1997 to 2010
finding: After controlling for family confounders, neither cesarean delivery nor antibiotic use during the first 2 years of life was associated with an increased risk of ADHD.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was not found to increase the risk of ADHD in children.
